versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Who is the guest lecturer today?
versions.promptTextZh: 今天的客座讲师是谁？
versions.transcript: Who is the guest lecturer today?
versions.transcriptZh: 今天的客座讲师是谁？

choices.label: It's on modern technology.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答只说明讲座主题是现代科技，没有回答来宾讲师是谁。

choices.label: Because students requested it.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答解释安排讲座的原因，没有给出讲师身份。

choices.label: It's part of the lecture series.
choices.labelZh: 这是讲座系列的一部分。
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答说明讲座属于某个系列，仍然没有说出谁来讲。

choices.label: A visiting researcher.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答给出来宾讲师的身份，是对 who 问句的自然回应。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Where can I find the class notes?
versions.promptTextZh: 我在哪里可以找到课堂笔记？
versions.transcript: Where can I find the class notes?
versions.transcriptZh: 我在哪里可以找到课堂笔记？

choices.label: After my class.
choices.explanationZh: 原句问“在哪里能找到课堂笔记”，这个回答说“我课后”，是在说时间，不能指出笔记的位置。

choices.label: Check on the class website.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答让对方去课程网站查看，直接回答了“哪里可以找到笔记”，是自然、有效的回应。

choices.label: They are 36 pages long.
choices.explanationZh: “36页长”是在说笔记长度，不是在回答去哪里找。

choices.label: They use the standard format.
choices.explanationZh: “使用标准格式”是在说格式特点，和寻找笔记的位置无关。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Who forgot to turn off the lights?
versions.promptTextZh: 谁忘记关灯了？
versions.transcript: Who forgot to turn off the lights?
versions.transcriptZh: 谁忘记关灯了？

choices.label: Bruce had a flashlight.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。题目问谁忘了关灯，Bruce 有手电筒只是在说他有什么物品，没有回答是谁忘关灯。

choices.label: The school office will send more lightbulbs.
choices.labelZh: 学校办公室会送更多灯泡来。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。学校办公室会送更多灯泡是在说补充设备，不是在说明谁忘记关灯。

choices.label: The cleaning crew finished all the rooms.
choices.labelZh: 清洁工完成了所有房间的清扫。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。清洁人员完成房间清扫与“谁忘关灯”没有直接关系。

choices.label: Annie needed to leave in a hurry.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。Annie 需要匆忙离开，能自然解释她可能忘了关灯，是对“谁忘了关灯”的最佳回应。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Why is the air conditioner in the dorm not working?
versions.promptTextZh: 宿舍的空调为什么坏了？
versions.transcript: Why is the air conditioner in the dorm not working?
versions.transcriptZh: 宿舍的空调为什么坏了？

choices.label: Yes, they work every day.
choices.explanationZh: 题干问空调为什么不工作，choice_1 只是说它们每天工作，既没有解释原因，也没有给出处理办法。

choices.label: I'll need to contact maintenance.
choices.explanationZh: 这是自然回应：说话人不知道具体故障原因，需要联系维修人员来检查并处理空调问题。

choices.label: Probably not before work.
choices.explanationZh: “可能不会在上班前”回答的是时间安排，和空调故障原因无关。

choices.label: I will be out next week.
choices.explanationZh: “我下周不在”只说明个人行程，不能回答空调为什么坏了。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Who is in charge of the event?
versions.promptTextZh: 谁负责这次活动？
versions.transcript: Who is in charge of the event?
versions.transcriptZh: 谁负责这次活动？

choices.label: Dr. West.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。问题问谁负责活动，直接回答 Dr. West 是负责人。

choices.label: In the main hall.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。In the main hall 回答地点，不能回答谁负责。

choices.label: Sarah can help.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。Sarah can help 只说 Sarah 能帮忙，没有说明谁 in charge。

choices.label: It's next week.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。It is next week 回答时间，不回答负责人。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Who is the tutor in the student success center today?
versions.promptTextZh: 今天学生成功中心的辅导老师是谁？
versions.transcript: Who is the tutor in the student success center today?
versions.transcriptZh: 今天学生成功中心的辅导老师是谁？

choices.label: In the main classroom.
choices.explanationZh: 问今天学生成功中心的 tutor 是谁；回答地点“在主教室”没有说明人选。

choices.label: I'll be there.
choices.explanationZh: “我会去那里”只回应自己是否到场，不回答 tutor 是谁。

choices.label: Probably the same from last week.
choices.explanationZh: 说“可能还是上周同一个人”是在回答 tutor 的身份，语境自然。

choices.label: She didn't take notes.
choices.explanationZh: “她没记笔记”转到笔记行为，和询问 tutor 人选无关。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Would you like to eat at the west dining hall tonight?
versions.promptTextZh: 你今晚想在西餐厅吃饭吗？
versions.transcript: Would you like to eat at the west dining hall tonight?
versions.transcriptZh: 你今晚想在西餐厅吃饭吗？

choices.label: My apartment is too small.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答谈自己的公寓大小，和是否去西餐厅吃饭无关。

choices.label: The new restaurant is open.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答只是说新餐厅开了，没有接受或婉拒晚餐邀请。

choices.label: I've never been to that store.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答把地点误听成商店，没有回应是否去食堂。

choices.label: I'll check my schedule.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答表示要查日程，合理回应今晚能不能一起吃饭。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Did you enjoy the gardening class?
versions.promptTextZh: 你喜欢园艺课吗？
versions.transcript: Did you enjoy the gardening class?
versions.transcriptZh: 你喜欢园艺课吗？

choices.label: Yes, it was very informative.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。问题问是否喜欢园艺课；“很有信息量”是对课程体验的正面评价，自然表示喜欢。

choices.label: Plants improve indoor air quality.
choices.labelZh: 植物能改善室内空气质量。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。这句泛谈植物改善室内空气质量，没有表达自己是否享受那门课。

choices.label: She waters her garden daily.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。这句说另一个人每天浇花，和提问者对园艺课的感受无关。

choices.label: Teachers enjoy seeing students grow.
choices.labelZh: 老师喜欢看到学生成长。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。这句借 grow 谈老师看学生成长，偏离了 gardening class 的个人评价。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Peter said he would look for supplies.
versions.promptTextZh: 彼得说他会去找补给品。
versions.transcript: Peter said he would look for supplies.
versions.transcriptZh: 彼得说他会去找补给品。

choices.label: What size did you buy?
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。原句说 Peter 要去找物资，这不是在询问买了什么尺码。

choices.label: It was a good-looking design.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。评价设计外观没有回应 Peter 要找物资这件事。

choices.label: I'll give him the list of what we need.
choices.labelZh: 我会把我们需要的东西清单给他。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。把所需物资清单给 Peter，正好配合他去找 supplies 的行动。

choices.label: This year it starts earlier than usual.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。谈今年开始时间，和找物资没有关系。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Did you enjoy the dean's talk yesterday?
versions.promptTextZh: 你喜欢昨天院长的演讲吗？
versions.transcript: Did you enjoy the dean's talk yesterday?
versions.transcriptZh: 你喜欢昨天院长的演讲吗？

choices.label: Yes, it was informative.
choices.explanationZh: “是的，很有信息量”直接评价昨天 dean 的 talk，回应自然。

choices.label: Yes, I plan to attend.
choices.explanationZh: talk 发生在昨天，“我计划参加”把它当成未来活动，时间不对。

choices.label: Not the greatest reason.
choices.explanationZh: “不是最好的理由”没有评价是否喜欢讲座。

choices.label: Maybe sometimes.
choices.explanationZh: “也许有时候”含糊，不回答这次 talk 的感受。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Can you turn down the volume?
versions.promptTextZh: 你能把音量调小点吗？
versions.transcript: Can you turn down the volume?
versions.transcriptZh: 你能把音量调小点吗？

choices.label: Yes, I think it is.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答只是同意某事，不能回应调低音量的请求。

choices.label: A very noisy concert.
choices.labelZh: 一场非常吵闹的音乐会。
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答描述嘈杂的音乐会，不是对请求的行动回应。

choices.label: Sure, sorry about that.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答表示会照做并道歉，是请求场景中自然的回应。

choices.label: No, I'm not going to return it.
choices.explanationZh: 这个回答谈归还东西，和音量请求无关。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: How come you volunteered?
versions.promptTextZh: 你为什么自愿报名？
versions.transcript: How come you volunteered?
versions.transcriptZh: 你为什么自愿报名？

choices.label: Yes, that was most likely true.
choices.explanationZh: 问为什么 volunteered，回答“那很可能是真的”没有给原因。

choices.label: All companies offer similar benefits.
choices.labelZh: 所有公司都提供类似的福利。
choices.explanationZh: “所有公司福利类似”偏到公司福利，不解释志愿原因。

choices.label: I was too busy.
choices.explanationZh: “我太忙了”更像拒绝或抱怨，不说明为什么 volunteered。

choices.label: I wanted to help my fellow students.
choices.explanationZh: “我想帮助同学”给出 volunteered 的动机，回应自然。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Maybe the power went out for this whole area.
versions.promptTextZh: 也许整个区域都停电了。
versions.transcript: Maybe the power went out for this whole area.
versions.transcriptZh: 也许整个区域都停电了。

choices.label: It's a device that runs on solar power.
choices.labelZh: 它是一台使用太阳能的设备。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。这句解释某设备靠太阳能运行，把 power 当能源来源，未回应整片区域是否停电。

choices.label: Yes, they usually go out to eat.
choices.labelZh: 是的，他们通常会出去吃饭。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。go out to eat 是外出吃饭，误接 went out，和停电判断无关。

choices.label: I thought it was a powerful speech.
choices.labelZh: 我原以为那是一场有力的演讲。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。powerful speech 是“有力的演讲”，误接 power，不能回应停电。

choices.label: It looks like the streetlights outside the dorm are still on.
choices.labelZh: 看起来宿舍外的路灯还亮着。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。街灯还亮着能反驳“整个区域停电”的猜测，是自然的现场判断。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Why is your desk so cluttered?
versions.promptTextZh: 你的书桌怎么这么乱？
versions.transcript: Why is your desk so cluttered?
versions.transcriptZh: 你的书桌怎么这么乱？

choices.label: I've been there once.
choices.explanationZh: 原句问桌子为什么这么乱，“我去过那里一次”没有解释桌面杂乱的原因。

choices.label: I've been too busy to organize it.
choices.explanationZh: 说自己太忙所以没整理，直接解释了桌子乱的原因，回应自然。

choices.label: The new furniture looks great.
choices.explanationZh: 新家具好看是在评价家具，不是在解释杂乱。

choices.label: It should arrive tomorrow.
choices.explanationZh: “明天会到”像是在说某个物品到货，和桌面为什么乱不匹配。

versions.label: Wofo M1
versions.promptText: Why did you choose this science course?
versions.promptTextZh: 你为什么选择这门理科课程？
versions.transcript: Why did you choose this science course?
versions.transcriptZh: 你为什么选择这门理科课程？

choices.label: I just submitted the science lab report.
choices.labelZh: 我刚提交了理科实验报告。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。问题问为什么选择这门科学课，提交实验报告是课后任务，不能说明选课原因。

choices.label: That's a good idea.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。“这是个好主意”是在评价建议，未回答选择课程的原因。

choices.label: My tuition is due soon.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。学费快到期只涉及缴费时间，与为什么选科学课无关。

choices.label: I like knowing how things work.
choices.labelZh: 我喜欢了解事物的运作原理。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。喜欢了解事物如何运作是选择科学课的理由，直接回应 why did you choose。

versions.label: Koala 08-12
versions.promptText: Choose the best response.
versions.promptTextZh: 选择最佳回答。

choices.label: I just submitted the science lab report.
choices.labelZh: 我刚提交了科学实验报告。

choices.label: That's a good idea.
My tuition is due soon.
I like knowing how things work.
choices.labelZh: 我喜欢了解事物运作的方式。
choices.explanationZh: 说话者问：“你为什么选择科学课程？”回答“我喜欢了解事物运作的方式”提供了选择科学课程的原因或动机，直接回答了问题。

versions.transcript: Why did you choose a science course?
versions.transcriptZh: 你为什么选择科学课程？

transcriptSentences.text: Why did you choose a science course?
transcriptSentences.textZh: 你为什么选择科学课程？

versions.note: 同题，材料文字版本不同

versions.label: Wofo M2
versions.promptText: Would you mind forwarding me the notes from yesterday's class?
versions.promptTextZh: 你介意把昨天的课堂笔记转发给我吗？
versions.transcript: Would you mind forwarding me the notes from yesterday's class?
versions.transcriptZh: 你介意把昨天的课堂笔记转发给我吗？

choices.label: I need to clean them up first.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。对方请求转发昨天的课堂笔记；“我需要先整理一下”说明自己有笔记并会先整理，再转发是合理回应。

choices.label: I don't think Tim took notes either.
choices.labelZh: 我觉得蒂姆也没做笔记。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。Tim 可能也没记笔记没有说明自己能不能转发，不能回应对方的请求。

choices.label: Class ran long.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。课堂拖堂只是描述上课情况，没有回应“能不能把笔记转发给我”。

choices.label: I didn't expect so many people to be there.
choices.labelZh: 我没想到会有那么多人在。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。人数很多出乎意料与课堂笔记和转发动作无关。

versions.label: Wofo M2
versions.promptText: Should we invite the whole club or just the officers?
versions.promptTextZh: 我们是邀请整个社团还是只邀请负责人？
versions.transcript: Should we invite the whole club or just the officers?
versions.transcriptZh: 我们是邀请整个社团还是只邀请负责人？

choices.label: Let's see what's on the agenda first.
choices.labelZh: 我们先看看议程上有什么吧。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。对方在决定邀请全体成员还是只邀请干部；先看看议程，意思是根据会议内容再决定邀请范围，回应自然。

choices.label: We need to send invitations.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。发送邀请只是下一步动作，没有回答应该邀请全体还是只邀请干部。

choices.label: The club room is more spacious.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。社团活动室更宽敞是在说地点条件，和邀请哪些人无关。

choices.label: Friday is better.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。Friday is better 只是在选择时间，不是在选择邀请对象。

versions.label: Wofo M2
versions.promptText: Who will be attending the conference?
versions.promptTextZh: 谁将参加会议？
versions.transcript: Who will be attending the conference?
versions.transcriptZh: 谁将参加会议？

choices.label: The conference call lasted two hours.
choices.labelZh: 电话会议持续了两个小时。
choices.explanationZh: 题干问谁会参加会议，choice_1 说电话会议持续两小时，回答了时长而不是人员。

choices.label: Most of our classmates, I think.
choices.labelZh: 我想，大部分是我们的同学。
choices.explanationZh: 这是自然回应：用“多数同学”直接回答参加会议的人。

choices.label: The professor took attendance during the afternoon class.
choices.labelZh: 教授在下午的课上点了名。
choices.explanationZh: 教授点名是课堂考勤，不是说明谁会去参加会议。

choices.label: No, I wasn't there.
choices.explanationZh: “不，我不在那里”只说明过去不在场，不能回答参会名单。

versions.label: Wofo M2
versions.promptText: Where is the campus wellness center?
versions.promptTextZh: 校园健康中心在哪里？
versions.transcript: Where is the campus wellness center?
versions.transcriptZh: 校园健康中心在哪里？

choices.label: The last appointment is at 2 p.m.
choices.labelZh: 最后一个预约时间是下午2点。
choices.explanationZh: 原句问健康中心在哪里，预约最晚几点是在说时间安排，不是地点。

choices.label: The wait time is three hours.
choices.explanationZh: 等待时间三小时说明服务耗时，不能回答地点。

choices.label: Near the registrar's office.
choices.explanationZh: “在注册办公室附近”给出了具体方位，正好回答 where 的问题。

choices.label: She's following the doctor's advice.
choices.labelZh: 她正在遵循医生的建议。
choices.explanationZh: 这句话在说某人遵医嘱，和健康中心的位置无关。

versions.label: Wofo M2
versions.promptText: Who is presenting our project?
versions.promptTextZh: 谁来展示我们的项目？
versions.transcript: Who is presenting our project?
versions.transcriptZh: 谁来展示我们的项目？

choices.label: I think Emily should.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。问题问谁来展示项目，回答认为 Emily 应该展示很自然。

choices.label: Everyone needs to register online.
choices.labelZh: 每个人都需要在线注册。
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。线上注册是手续信息，不回答谁展示。

choices.label: It was a lively class.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。评价课堂气氛不能回应 presenting our project。

choices.label: There is new homework.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。新作业和谁做展示无关。

versions.label: Wofo M2
versions.promptText: I don't know how many people will join us tonight for study group.
versions.promptTextZh: 我不知道今晚有多少人会来参加我们的学习小组。
versions.transcript: I don't know how many people will join us tonight for study group.
versions.transcriptZh: 我不知道今晚有多少人会来参加我们的学习小组。

choices.label: The membership dues.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。membership dues 是会费，不能回应今晚有多少人参加学习小组。

choices.label: The auditorium on the second floor.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。二楼礼堂是地点信息，不回答人数。

choices.label: Last night it rained a lot.
choices.explanationZh: 不自然。昨晚下雨和今晚参加学习小组的人数无关。

choices.label: At least five said they would come.
choices.labelZh: 至少有五个人说他们会来。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。At least five said they would come 直接给出预计参加人数。

versions.label: Koala 04-05
versions.promptText: Choose the best response.
versions.promptTextZh: 选择最佳回答。

choices.label: The membership dues.
The auditorium on the second floor.
Last night it rained a lot.

versions.label: Wofo M18

choices.label: The train goes to the airport.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。火车去机场是在说交通方式，不回答航班时间。

choices.label: We need to wait for our luggage.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。等行李是在说机场流程，不说明返程航班时间。

versions.promptText: Do you know whether Professor Harris will let us change our project topic?

versions.transcript: Do you know whether Professor Harris will let us change our project topic?
versions.transcriptZh: 你知道哈里斯教授是否会让我们更改项目主题吗？

choices.label: I had to read the book several times.
choices.labelZh: 我不得不把书读了好几遍。
choices.explanationZh: A 说自己把书读了好几遍，和是否询问教授无关。

choices.label: I've emailed him to ask about it.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：I've emailed him to ask about it 说明已经发邮件问教授这件事。

choices.label: Our options are quite limited.
choices.explanationZh: C 说选项很有限，没有说明是否知道教授允许不允许。

choices.label: I don't think they're worth mentioning.
choices.explanationZh: D 说不值得提，不能回答是否知道教授的态度。

versions.promptText: Where can I find discounted textbooks?

versions.transcript: Where can I find discounted textbooks?
versions.transcriptZh: 我在哪里能找到打折的教科书？

choices.label: Your best option is to look online.
choices.labelZh: 你最好的选择是上网找。
choices.explanationZh: 题干问去哪里找便宜教材，online 给出具体寻找渠道。

choices.label: I prefer reading nonfiction.
choices.labelZh: 我更喜欢读非小说类的书。
choices.explanationZh: 这是在说阅读偏好，不是在告诉对方哪里能买 discounted textbooks。

choices.label: Yes, I believe it is.
choices.explanationZh: 原句不是 yes/no 问句，答 yes 基本是对空气点头。

choices.label: I need reading glasses.
choices.explanationZh: 看到 reading 就跑去眼镜，和买教材不是一回事。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: Why do the children have to take turns going outside?
versions.promptTextZh: 为什么孩子们必须轮流去外面？
versions.transcript: Why do the children have to take turns going outside?
versions.transcriptZh: 为什么孩子们必须轮流去外面？

choices.label: I need to check the website.
choices.explanationZh: A 说需要查网站，不是在评价 playground。

choices.label: Those students already graduated.
choices.explanationZh: B 说那些学生已经毕业，和 playground 的大小或质量无关。

choices.label: The playground is pretty small.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：The playground is pretty small 是对新 playground 的直接评价。

choices.label: The teachers are amazing.
choices.explanationZh: D 评价老师很好，不是在评价 playground。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: If you're comfortable with the schedule, we can book the lab for tomorrow.
versions.promptTextZh: 如果你觉得时间安排没问题，我们明天可以预约实验室。
versions.transcript: If you're comfortable with the schedule, we can book the lab for tomorrow.
versions.transcriptZh: 如果你觉得时间安排没问题，我们明天可以预约实验室。

choices.label: I think her office is on the second floor.
choices.labelZh: 我认为她的办公室在二楼。
choices.explanationZh: 原句在确认明天订实验室的安排，这句突然说某人的办公室位置，接不上。

choices.label: Yes, the lab equipment is brand-new.
choices.labelZh: 是的，实验室设备都是全新的。
choices.explanationZh: 这句只评价 lab equipment，新不新不等于同不同意明天订 lab。

choices.label: I haven't had time to read books recently.
choices.explanationZh: 读书时间和 booking the lab 没关系，话题直接换频道。

choices.label: Sure, that works for me.
choices.explanationZh: 对方提出“如果你觉得时间可以，我们就订明天”，这句明确表示这个安排可行。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: That was an insightful talk.
versions.promptTextZh: 那是一场很有见地的演讲。
versions.transcript: That was an insightful talk.
versions.transcriptZh: 那是一场很有见地的演讲。

choices.label: The astronomy course has a lab and a lecture.
choices.labelZh: 天文学课程包含实验课和讲座。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。原文是“That was an insightful talk.”；“The astronomy course has a lab and a lecture.”没有直接回应这句话的核心意思。

choices.label: On a different site.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。原文是“That was an insightful talk.”；“On a different site.”没有直接回应这句话的核心意思。

choices.label: That professor is a real expert in her field.
choices.labelZh: 那位教授确实是她所在领域的专家。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。原文是“That was an insightful talk.”；“That professor is a real expert in her field.”能自然回应这句话。

choices.label: Let's meet in the library to review for the test.
choices.labelZh: 我们去图书馆复习备考吧。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。原文是“That was an insightful talk.”；“Let's meet in the library to review for the test.”没有直接回应这句话的核心意思。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: What time does the marching band practice?
versions.promptTextZh: 行进乐队什么时候练习？
versions.transcript: What time does the marching band practice?
versions.transcriptZh: 行进乐队什么时候练习？

choices.label: Practice is so important.
choices.explanationZh: 问的是具体时间，这句只是评论“练习”本身，听完还是不知道几点。

choices.label: On the football field this time.
choices.explanationZh: 答成了地点；如果原句是 Where does... 才可能对。

choices.label: I don't know but I'll find out for you.
choices.labelZh: 我不知道，但我会帮你查一下。
choices.explanationZh: 问时间时，不知道答案也可以接一句“我去查”，这是唯一一个在信息缺失时仍然能完成回应的选项。

choices.label: They marched in unison to the drum beat.
choices.labelZh: 他们随着鼓点齐步行进。
choices.explanationZh: 这句像在写阅兵画面，不是在回答练习几点。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: The school assembly was very engaging.
versions.promptTextZh: 学校的集会非常吸引人。
versions.transcript: The school assembly was very engaging.
versions.transcriptZh: 学校的集会非常吸引人。

choices.label: Assemble the group and we'll discuss the work project.
choices.labelZh: 召集大家，我们来讨论这个工作项目。
choices.explanationZh: 这句把 assembly 拆成动词 assemble，变成召集团队开工，词形相似但意思跑了。

choices.label: All of the students enjoyed it.
choices.explanationZh: 听力说 assembly 很吸引人，这句补充学生都喜欢它，评价方向一致。

choices.label: I was so engaged with the book that I finished it in one night.
choices.labelZh: 我对那本书太着迷了，一晚上就把它看完了。
choices.explanationZh: 这句抓了 engaged，但对象变成一本书，不是 school assembly。

choices.label: The school year begins earlier in some areas.
choices.labelZh: 有些地区的学年开始得更早。
choices.explanationZh: 这句抓 school，但在说学年开始时间，和 assembly 的效果无关。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: What should I bring to the meeting?
versions.promptTextZh: 我应该带什么去开会？
versions.transcript: What should I bring to the meeting?
versions.transcriptZh: 我应该带什么去开会？

choices.label: Just yourself.
choices.explanationZh: 题干问需要带什么，这句直接说明不用带东西，人到就行。

choices.label: In the chemistry lab.
choices.explanationZh: 这是地点答案，适合回答 Where，不适合回答 bring what。

choices.label: I took notes.
choices.explanationZh: 这句说自己做了笔记，没有告诉对方要不要带笔记或其他东西。

choices.label: She'll present during her next class.
choices.explanationZh: 这句在说另一个人的安排，和这次 meeting 要带什么无关。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: I assumed the cafeteria would serve breakfast until noon.
versions.promptTextZh: 我以为食堂会一直供应早餐到中午。
versions.transcript: I assumed the cafeteria would serve breakfast until noon.
versions.transcriptZh: 我以为食堂会一直供应早餐到中午。

choices.label: It's on the other side of campus.
choices.explanationZh: 这句回答的是 cafeteria 在哪里，不解释为什么早餐没有到 noon。

choices.label: Yes, the library has extended hours.
choices.labelZh: 是的，图书馆的开放时间延长了。
choices.explanationZh: 这句把营业时间换成 library，地点错了。

choices.label: Let's call her this afternoon.
choices.labelZh: 我们下午给她打电话吧。
choices.explanationZh: 原句不是在讨论某个人，也没有需要 call her 的信息。

choices.label: They changed the schedule last week.
choices.labelZh: 他们上周更改了时间表。
choices.explanationZh: 对方以为早餐供应到中午，这句解释实际安排变了，所以原来的假设不成立。

versions.label: Wofo M19
versions.promptText: The dance performance is happening this evening.
versions.promptTextZh: 舞蹈表演今晚举行。
versions.transcript: The dance performance is happening this evening.
versions.transcriptZh: 舞蹈表演今晚举行。

choices.label: The price has gone down.
choices.explanationZh: A 说价格下降了，和今晚的舞蹈表演无关。

choices.explanationZh: B 泛泛说跳舞是好运动，不是在回应这个表演。

choices.label: That's my favorite book.
choices.explanationZh: D 说那是自己最喜欢的书，把 dance performance 话题带偏了。

versions.transcriptZh: 预计今天下午我们徒步时气温会上升。

choices.labelZh: 我不确定价格为什么上涨了。
choices.explanationZh: A 把 hot/hike 误带到 price hike，讨论涨价原因，跑题。

choices.labelZh: 课堂展示进行得很完美。
choices.explanationZh: B 说课堂展示很顺利，和下午徒步天气无关。

choices.label: I already ate lunch at the dining hall.
choices.labelZh: 我已经在食堂吃过午饭了。

choices.explanationZh: 不正确。原文是“When will the club meeting minutes be ready?”；“No, check with Oscar first.”没有回答这句话的核心问题。

choices.label: The study room is booked.
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。原文是“When will the club meeting minutes be ready?”；“The study room is booked.”没有回答这句话的核心问题。

choices.label: Yes, I left them on his desk.
choices.labelZh: 是的，我放在他桌子上了。
choices.explanationZh: 不正确。原文是“When will the club meeting minutes be ready?”；“Yes, I left them on his desk.”没有回答这句话的核心问题。

choices.explanationZh: A 说下周提交艺术作品集，和今晚去音乐会无关。

choices.explanationZh: B 说画廊开到六点，地点和活动都不对。

versions.promptText: Why did you miss the club meeting yesterday?

versions.transcript: Why did you miss the club meeting yesterday?
versions.transcriptZh: 你昨天为什么错过了社团会议？

choices.label: The schedule was sent to everyone.
choices.labelZh: 日程已经发给每个人了。
choices.explanationZh: A 说日程发给了所有人，不解释为什么缺席。

choices.label: I have the calendar here.
choices.explanationZh: B 说自己有日历，不回答缺席原因。

choices.label: The teacher approves of our group.
choices.explanationZh: C 说老师同意小组安排，和缺席原因无关。

choices.label: I was feeling a bit sick.

versions.promptText: If we put in the effort, the professor will appreciate it.
versions.promptTextZh: 如果我们付出努力，教授会感激的。
versions.transcript: If we put in the effort, the professor will appreciate it.
versions.transcriptZh: 如果我们付出努力，教授会感激的。

choices.label: They like their professor, too.
choices.labelZh: 他们也喜欢他们的教授。
choices.explanationZh: 原句说教授会认可努力，这句变成别人喜欢教授，逻辑不是同一件事。

choices.label: That's right, there are no office hours today.
choices.labelZh: 没错，今天没有办公时间。

choices.label: Please put it over there.

choices.label: Traffic signs help drivers stay safe and informed.

choices.explanationZh: D 泛泛说交通标志帮助司机，不是在说明自己的研究方向。

choices.label: I'll contact the electrician.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：灯一直闪，联系电工是最直接的处理方式。

choices.label: The bag is heavy.

choices.label: I couldn't book the flight.

choices.label: Mateo will join us.

choices.label: Oh, I'm busy on Friday.

choices.label: I'll order those later.

choices.explanationZh: 此句提及Jose帮忙，但未说明讲座地点，且“No”与后文矛盾，逻辑不一致。

choices.explanationZh: 此句答地点（main office），而问题问原因（why），范畴错误。

choices.explanationZh: 此句答时间（Thursday），非原因，不匹配疑问词why。

choices.label: Let’s schedule that soon.
choices.explanationZh: 此句是提议安排事项，与‘项目延迟原因’无因果关系。

choices.label: The students had difficulties.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。‘The students had difficulties’直接给出原因（学生遇到困难），语法、语义与问题完全对应，是唯一因果性解释。

versions.transcriptZh: 谁在组织大学的慈善活动？

choices.label: It will be held next weekend.
choices.explanationZh: 此句答‘时间’（next weekend），而非‘谁组织’，信息类型错配。

choices.explanationZh: 正确。‘We’re still finalizing the details’暗示组织工作正在进行中，自然涵盖‘谁在组织’（即‘we’），是面对未明确责任人时的标准、务实回应。

choices.label: The organization is very committed.
choices.explanationZh: 此句泛泛夸赞组织方态度，未指明主体（who），无法回答疑问词who。

choices.label: The event supports a local charity.
choices.labelZh: 这个活动支持一家本地慈善机构。
choices.explanationZh: 此句答‘目的’（支持慈善），非‘主体’（who），属于答非所问。

versions.promptText: Did you get a chance to review the group project slides?

choices.explanationZh: 正确。‘Not yet, but I’ll check them later’准确回应‘是否已审阅’：否定现状+承诺后续行动，时态与意图均恰当。

choices.label: Actually, we have a good chance of winning.
choices.labelZh: 事实上，我们很有机会赢。
choices.explanationZh: 此句谈‘获胜概率’，与审阅幻灯片这一具体任务无关。

choices.label: I think so, but I need to choose a topic first.
choices.labelZh: 我想是的，但我需要先选个主题。
choices.explanationZh: 此句混入‘选题’新信息，且‘I think so’模糊不清，未明确回答是否已审阅。

choices.label: Sure, it’s important to review your notes after class.
choices.labelZh: 当然，课后复习笔记很重要。
choices.explanationZh: 此句泛泛而谈复习笔记的重要性，未针对‘group project slides’作任何确认或否认，属转移话题。

choices.explanationZh: 错误：说明具体时间，而非学习偏好场所或方式。

choices.explanationZh: 错误：陈述过往学科，未说明当前偏好方式。

choices.label: It’s quite challenging.
choices.explanationZh: 错误：评价难度，未描述自身学习习惯。

choices.label: In a quiet room.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：直接回答‘偏好如何学习’，指出‘在安静的房间’这一环境偏好。

choices.explanationZh: 此句答截止时间，非执行主体，信息类别错误。

choices.explanationZh: 正确。‘All students are able to’明确主语‘all students’，直接回答who，并隐含‘everyone is doing it’，符合疑问词who的预期答案。

choices.label: It should be pretty easy.
choices.explanationZh: 此句评价难度，未指明行为主体。

choices.label: There are progress updates weekly.
choices.explanationZh: 此句讲进度更新频率，属过程管理信息，不回答‘谁做’这一主体问题。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。提及教授演讲笔记，与当前会议地点问题无任何关联。

versions.transcript: Seems like the lab is locked. Do we wait or leave?
versions.transcriptZh: 实验室好像锁门了。我们是等还是离开？

choices.explanationZh: 'Sure, we can start with that.' 准确理解‘leading with the background section’指在报告中先讲背景部分，并给予肯定配合，语用恰当。

choices.label: Yes, these sofa cushions are quite nice.
choices.labelZh: 是的，这些沙发垫很不错。
choices.explanationZh: 'Yes, these sofa cushions are quite nice.' 完全脱离‘background section’（背景章节）的学术语境，属无关联干扰项。

choices.label: It's a computer-generated image.
choices.labelZh: 这是一张电脑生成的图片。
choices.explanationZh: 'It's a computer-generated image.' 引入无关技术细节，未回应是否愿意承担该环节，答非所问。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: The research library offers various resources.
versions.promptTextZh: 研究图书馆提供各种资源。
versions.transcript: The research library offers various resources.
versions.transcriptZh: 研究图书馆提供各种资源。

choices.label: Both students offered their various perspectives on the class topic.
choices.labelZh: 两位学生都就课程主题提供了各自的看法。
choices.explanationZh: 复述‘various perspectives’，但原文指资源（resources）而非观点（perspectives），用词不当。

choices.label: Yes, some metals are considered to be limited resources.
choices.labelZh: 是的，有些金属被认为是有限资源。
choices.explanationZh: 讨论金属资源有限性，将‘library resources’错误理解为自然资源。

choices.label: No, I believe that the library is on the second floor of this building.
choices.labelZh: 不，我认为图书馆在这栋楼的二楼。
choices.explanationZh: 否认图书馆位置，但原句未提楼层，属无依据反驳。

choices.label: I'll keep that in mind for my upcoming school project.
choices.labelZh: 我会在我即将完成的学校项目中记住这一点。
choices.explanationZh: 将图书馆资源与自身项目需求联系，自然承接话题，体现恰当的话轮衔接与语用关联。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: Let's take a quick peek at our class schedule.
versions.promptTextZh: 我们快速看一下课程表吧。
versions.transcript: Let's take a quick peek at our class schedule.
versions.transcriptZh: 我们快速看一下课程表吧。

choices.label: We got to class a little late.
choices.explanationZh: 'We got to class a little late.' 描述过去行为，未回应‘take a quick peek’（快速查看）的即时行动建议。

choices.label: Is it available online?
choices.explanationZh: 'Is it available online?' 自然承接‘class schedule’，关切获取渠道，符合协作场景中的实用追问。

choices.label: Is this the study you were looking at?
choices.labelZh: 这是你刚才在看的资料吗？
choices.explanationZh: 'Is this the study you were looking at?' 引入新名词‘study’，且用指示代词‘this’无前文指代，语境脱节。

choices.label: Maybe he'll reply right away.
choices.explanationZh: 'Maybe he'll reply right away.' 引入无关第三人‘he’及‘reply’动作，与查看课表无逻辑关联。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: What do you think of the new gym in the dorms?
versions.promptTextZh: 你觉得宿舍的新健身房怎么样？
versions.transcript: What do you think of the new gym in the dorms?
versions.transcriptZh: 你觉得宿舍的新健身房怎么样？

choices.label: I think the weather is fine
choices.explanationZh: 天气与宿舍新健身房无关，完全偏离话题。

choices.label: Last Thursday, I believe
choices.explanationZh: 时间‘Last Thursday’无法回答对健身房的主观看法，信息不匹配。

choices.label: I need to see the facilities first
choices.explanationZh: 该选项表示需实地考察后再评价，是对‘你觉得如何’这一开放性问题的合理、谨慎回应。

choices.label: Fitness is important
choices.explanationZh: 泛泛而谈‘健身重要’未针对‘新健身房’具体评价，空洞且不切题。

I need to see the facilities first.

choices.label: Fitness is important.

versions.transcript: Did you find the lecture inspiring?
versions.transcriptZh: 你觉得讲座鼓舞人心吗？

choices.label: Yes, in the auditorium.
choices.explanationZh: 地点‘auditorium’不能回答‘是否鼓舞人心’这一评价性问题，答非所问。

choices.label: It will be a brief lecture.

choices.explanationZh: 该选项预测讲座时长，未回应‘是否鼓舞人心’这一已完成动作的评价请求。

choices.label: Yes, it certainly was.
choices.explanationZh: 该选项明确肯定且使用强调副词‘certainly’，准确、自然地回应了对方对过去讲座感受的询问。

choices.label: I have a class tomorrow.
choices.explanationZh: 该选项转移话题至明日课程，回避问题，不符合应答要求。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: The concert was absolutely stunning.
versions.promptTextZh: 这场音乐会绝对令人惊叹。
versions.transcript: The concert was absolutely stunning.
versions.transcriptZh: 这场音乐会绝对令人惊叹。

choices.label: I enjoy live music
choices.explanationZh: 该选项表达个人对现场音乐的喜爱，自然承接‘音乐会令人震撼’的情感共鸣，语用恰当。

choices.label: Yes, the author really wrote a masterpiece
choices.labelZh: 是的，作者确实创作了一部杰作
choices.explanationZh: ‘作者’和‘剧本’暗示文学作品，与‘音乐会’主题不符，概念错位。

choices.label: I've never heard of that play
choices.labelZh: 我从没听说过那部戏剧
choices.explanationZh: ‘那部剧’与‘音乐会’无关，混淆艺术形式，明显错误。

choices.label: Probably on campus somewhere
choices.labelZh: 可能就在校园的某个地方
choices.explanationZh: ‘可能在校内某处’是对地点的猜测，但原句是评价性感叹，无需定位。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: How often do you travel to other countries?
versions.promptTextZh: 你多久去一次其他国家旅行？
versions.transcript: How often do you travel to other countries?
versions.transcriptZh: 你多久去一次其他国家旅行？

choices.label: I'm too busy with schoolwork to travel very much.
choices.labelZh: 我学业太忙，没有太多时间旅行。
choices.explanationZh: 'I'm too busy with schoolwork to travel very much.' 直接回答频率（how often），以‘too busy...very much’表明极少旅行，符合问句焦点。

choices.label: I enjoy visiting other countries.
choices.labelZh: 我喜欢去其他国家旅行。
choices.explanationZh: 'I enjoy visiting other countries.' 表达态度而非频次，无法回答‘how often’，信息类型不符。

choices.label: You might need a visa.
choices.explanationZh: 'You might need a visa.' 是旅行前提条件提醒，非对频率的描述，答非所问。

choices.label: There is an information session for the exchange program.
choices.labelZh: 有一个关于交换生项目的说明会。
choices.explanationZh: 'There is an information session for the exchange program.' 陈述事件存在，未涉及个人行为频率，完全偏离问题。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: Would you take a moment to evaluate the clarity of the introduction?
versions.promptTextZh: 你愿意花点时间评估一下引言部分的清晰度吗？
versions.transcript: Would you take a moment to evaluate the clarity of the introduction?
versions.transcriptZh: 你愿意花点时间评估一下引言部分的清晰度吗？

choices.label: Yes, the weather has been really clear lately
choices.labelZh: 是的，最近天气确实很晴朗。
choices.explanationZh: 'Yes, the weather has been really clear lately' 误将‘clarity’（清晰度）听作天气‘clear’，属语音干扰型错误。

choices.label: The final exam is the largest component of the class grade
choices.labelZh: 期末考试是课程成绩中最大的组成部分。
choices.explanationZh: 'The final exam is the largest component of the class grade' 引入评分标准，与‘introduction’s clarity’无逻辑关联。

choices.label: Let me just finish writing this email
choices.labelZh: 让我先把这封邮件写完。
choices.explanationZh: 'Let me just finish writing this email' 推迟评估，回避任务，不符合‘take a moment to evaluate’的即时协作要求。

choices.label: I'm not sure the evidence supports his conclusion
choices.labelZh: 我不确定证据是否支持他的结论。
choices.explanationZh: 'I'm not sure the evidence supports his conclusion' 聚焦论证强度，是学术语境中评价引言（常含论点/证据预告）清晰性的典型方式，切中‘clarity’的深层含义。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: I might not make it to the professor's office hours.
versions.promptTextZh: 我可能赶不上教授的答疑时间了。
versions.transcript: I might not make it to the professor's office hours.
versions.transcriptZh: 我可能赶不上教授的答疑时间了。

choices.label: How many hours did it take to get there?
choices.labelZh: 花了多少个小时才到那里？
choices.explanationZh: 错误：提问‘花了多少小时到达？’与原句‘我可能赶不上教授的办公时间’无关，原句表达的是不确定性而非路程耗时。

choices.label: Of course, feel free to come along
choices.labelZh: 当然，随时欢迎你一起来
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘当然，欢迎一起来’是主动邀请，但原句是表达可能缺席的担忧，此回应未提供实际帮助或替代方案。

choices.label: Did you have the same professor for that class?
choices.labelZh: 你那门课的教授也是同一个人吗？
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘你那门课也是这位教授教的吗？’偏离话题，原句未提及课程或教授身份，属无关追问。

choices.label: You know you can always email him, right?
choices.labelZh: 你知道你随时可以给他发邮件，对吧？
choices.explanationZh: 正确：‘你知道随时可以发邮件给他吧？’是恰当的 pragmatic 回应——针对‘可能赶不上办公时间’提供合理替代方案（email），符合日常学术交流惯例。

versions.label: Wofo M34
versions.promptText: Are you attending the river conservation seminar next week?
versions.promptTextZh: 你下周参加河流保护研讨会吗？
versions.transcript: Are you attending the river conservation seminar next week?
versions.transcriptZh: 你下周参加河流保护研讨会吗？

choices.label: She is studying to be a wildlife conservationist
choices.labelZh: 她正在学习成为一名野生动物保护专家
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘她正在学习成为野生动物保护主义者’引入无关第三人，未回答‘你是否参加’这一直接问题。

choices.label: No, I was unable to attend
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘不，我没去成’使用过去时，但原句问的是‘下周’（next week）的将来事件，时态矛盾。

choices.label: Yes, I want to protect the animals living in aquatic habitats
choices.labelZh: 是的，我想保护生活在水生栖息地的动物
choices.explanationZh: 正确：‘是的，我想保护水生栖息地中的动物’既肯定出席，又给出贴合‘river conservation seminar’主题的合理动机，语义连贯、语用得体。

choices.label: The new panels will help conserve energy in our dorm
choices.labelZh: 新面板将有助于节约我们宿舍的能源
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘新面板将帮助节约宿舍能源’话题完全偏移（energy conservation ≠ river conservation），属无关信息。

versions.label: Wofo M35
versions.promptText: What can we do to reduce university expenses?
versions.promptTextZh: 我们能做些什么来减少大学开支？
versions.transcript: What can we do to reduce university expenses?
versions.transcriptZh: 我们能做些什么来减少大学开支？

choices.label: A committee is working on the issue now
choices.labelZh: 一个委员会正在处理这个问题
choices.explanationZh: 正确：‘一个委员会正在处理这个问题’直接回应‘如何减少大学开支’的建议性提问，指出已有机制应对，语义相关且务实。

choices.label: I had some unexpected personal expenses
choices.labelZh: 我有一些意外的个人开支
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘我有一些意外的个人开支’转为个人财务，未涉及大学层面开支，范围错位。

choices.label: We went over the classroom budget last quarter
choices.labelZh: 我们上个季度审查了教室预算
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘我们上季度审查了教室预算’仅提局部预算（classroom），未覆盖‘university expenses’整体，以偏概全。

choices.label: The company's revenue summary has been posted
choices.labelZh: 公司的收入摘要已经发布
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘公司营收摘要已发布’主语‘公司’与‘university’无关，机构主体错误。

versions.label: Wofo M35
versions.promptText: What's the best way to learn programming?
versions.promptTextZh: 学习编程的最佳方法是什么？
versions.transcript: What's the best way to learn programming?
versions.transcriptZh: 学习编程的最佳方法是什么？

choices.label: I just learned that it closed last month
choices.labelZh: 我刚知道它上个月就关门了
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘我刚得知它上个月关闭了’指代不明（‘it’未定义），且与‘如何学编程’无逻辑关系。

choices.label: Our literature class has its own book club
choices.labelZh: 我们文学课有自己的读书俱乐部
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘我们的文学课有自己的读书会’完全偏离主题（programming），属话题错置。

choices.label: We had to completely reprogram it to get it to work
choices.labelZh: 我们不得不完全重新编程才能让它工作
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘我们不得不彻底重写程序才能让它运行’描述具体技术操作，但未回答‘最佳学习方法’这一泛问，且过于狭窄。

choices.label: I'm probably not the best person to ask about that
choices.labelZh: 我可能不是回答这个问题的最佳人选
choices.explanationZh: 正确：‘我可能不是问这个问题的最佳人选’是谦逊、真实的回避策略，当说话人缺乏专业知识时，此回应语用恰当、避免误导。

versions.label: Wofo M35
versions.promptText: You okay if we partner up for the econ project?
versions.promptTextZh: 我们一起做经济学项目，你觉得行吗？
versions.transcript: You okay if we partner up for the econ project?
versions.transcriptZh: 我们一起做经济学项目，你觉得行吗？

choices.label: We could try the campus café
choices.labelZh: 我们可以去校园咖啡馆试试。
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘我们可以去校园咖啡馆’是转移地点，未回应‘是否愿意组队’的核心请求，属回避。

choices.label: Have you ever played before?
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘你以前玩过吗？’将‘econ project’误听为游戏/运动，概念错配，理解错误。

choices.label: I'd love to work with you!
choices.labelZh: 我很乐意和你一起合作！
choices.explanationZh: 正确：‘我很乐意和你一起做！’明确接受合作提议，积极、礼貌、语用恰当，符合社交常规。

choices.label: That's okay, I can ask someone else
choices.labelZh: 没关系，我可以问问别人。
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘没关系，我可以找别人’虽语法正确，但属消极拒绝，与原句中‘you okay if…’的协商语气不匹配，非首选回应。

versions.label: Wofo M35
versions.promptText: The library offers digital books.
versions.promptTextZh: 图书馆提供电子书。
versions.transcript: The library offers digital books.
versions.transcriptZh: 图书馆提供电子书。

choices.label: That's very convenient
choices.explanationZh: 'That's very convenient' 直接评价数字图书服务带来的便利性，准确回应‘offers’隐含的价值判断，语用得体。

choices.label: I'll take your offer
choices.explanationZh: 'I'll take your offer' 错误预设对方在提供图书（offer是动词，非名词），且图书馆服务非‘offer’而是‘provides’。

choices.label: I have to clean the house
choices.explanationZh: 'I have to clean the house' 完全无关的个人事务，未对服务本身做任何反应。

choices.label: They're right there
choices.explanationZh: 'They're right there' 指代不清（‘they’指代什么？），且若指数字书则不合逻辑（数字资源无物理位置），语义断裂。

versions.label: Wofo M35
versions.promptText: Looks like the library has new books. Shall we have a peek?
versions.promptTextZh: 图书馆好像有新书了。我们要不要去看看？
versions.transcript: Looks like the library has new books. Shall we have a peek?
versions.transcriptZh: 图书馆好像有新书了。我们要不要去看看？

choices.label: The new library opens next semester
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘新图书馆下学期开放’与‘图书馆有新书，要不要看看？’无逻辑关联，且未回应提议（peek），属信息错位。

choices.label: Sure, I should be free after class
choices.labelZh: 好啊，我下课后应该有空。
choices.explanationZh: 正确：‘好的，我下课后应该有空’直接接受邀请（Shall we have a peek?），表明意愿与可行性，语用恰当、自然承接。

choices.label: Yes, the peak hours are in the evening
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘高峰期在晚上’答非所问，原句焦点是‘新书’和‘一起浏览’，而非开放时段或人流量。

choices.label: I read one of her books last year
choices.labelZh: 我去年读过她的一本书。
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘我去年读过她的一本书’偷换主语（‘她’未定义），且脱离当前提议，属无关联想。

versions.label: Wofo M35
versions.promptText: Who directed the movie you watched last night?
versions.promptTextZh: 谁执导了你昨晚看的那部电影？
versions.transcript: Who directed the movie you watched last night?
versions.transcriptZh: 谁执导了你昨晚看的那部电影？

choices.label: I'll have to look that up
choices.explanationZh: 正确：‘我得查一下’是面对未知信息的标准、礼貌回应，承认不确定性且承诺行动，语用恰当。

choices.label: They only come out at night
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘它们只在夜间出现’将‘movie’误听为夜行生物，语义荒谬。

choices.label: You'll have to move it eventually
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘你最终得把它搬走’无上下文支持‘it’指代电影，且与导演问题无关。

choices.label: Campus extends pretty far in that direction
choices.labelZh: 校园在那个方向延伸很远
choices.explanationZh: 错误：‘校园在那个方向延伸得很远’描述地理，与电影导演毫无关联。

versions.label: Wofo M35
versions.promptText: Why isn't the library open during the holiday break?
versions.promptTextZh: 为什么假期期间图书馆不开放？
versions.transcript: Why isn't the library open during the holiday break?
versions.transcriptZh: 为什么假期期间图书馆不开放？

choices.explanationZh: 题干问已经听完 presentation 的感受，这句像是在拒绝未来安排。

choices.label: I found the information very engaging.
choices.labelZh: 我觉得信息非常引人入胜。
choices.explanationZh: 问 enjoy 得怎么样，这句用内容很吸引人来评价 presentation，正面回答了感受。

choices.label: I think it was in the auditorium.
choices.explanationZh: 这是地点信息，不是对 presentation 的评价。

choices.label: No, the lighting was too dark.
choices.explanationZh: 这句评价的是灯光条件，不是 history project presentation 本身；而且 No 接在 How did you enjoy 后面也别扭。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: Can you help me understand how to use the new printer?
versions.promptTextZh: 你能帮我弄明白怎么用那台新打印机吗？
versions.transcript: Can you help me understand how to use the new printer?
versions.transcriptZh: 你能帮我弄明白怎么用那台新打印机吗？

choices.label: The old printer is broken.
choices.explanationZh: 对方问能不能教他用新打印机，旧打印机坏不坏不是回应这个请求。

choices.label: It's located on the first floor.
choices.explanationZh: 这句只告诉位置，不等于愿意帮忙，也没有解释怎么用。

choices.label: It started at nine a.m.
choices.explanationZh: 打印机不是讲座，started at nine 听起来像误入另一个题目。

choices.label: Sure, I'd be happy to.
choices.explanationZh: 题干是 Can you help me...，这句直接接受帮忙请求。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: How can I enhance my skills?
versions.promptTextZh: 我如何能提升我的技能？
versions.transcript: How can I enhance my skills?
versions.transcriptZh: 我如何能提升我的技能？

choices.label: Enroll in a computer science class.
choices.labelZh: 报名参加计算机科学课程。
choices.explanationZh: 题干问怎么提升技能，报名上课是具体可执行的方法。

choices.label: My friend collects calculators.
choices.explanationZh: 计算器收藏挺有个性，但不能提升对方的 skills。

choices.label: My job offers commuter benefits.
choices.labelZh: 我的工作提供通勤福利。
choices.explanationZh: 通勤福利是工作待遇，不是技能提升方案。

choices.label: Computers are expensive.
choices.explanationZh: 这句只是在抱怨价格，没有给出如何 enhance skills 的办法。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: What should I bring to the meeting?
versions.promptTextZh: 我应该带什么去开会？
versions.transcript: What should I bring to the meeting?
versions.transcriptZh: 我应该带什么去开会？

choices.label: Just yourself.
choices.explanationZh: 题干问需要带什么，这句直接说明不用带东西，人到就行。

choices.label: In the chemistry lab.
choices.explanationZh: 这是地点答案，适合回答 Where，不适合回答 bring what。

choices.label: I took notes.
choices.explanationZh: 这句说自己做了笔记，没有告诉对方要不要带笔记或其他东西。

choices.label: She'll present during her next class.
choices.explanationZh: 这句在说另一个人的安排，和这次 meeting 要带什么无关。

versions.label: Koala 04-27
versions.promptText: Choose the best response.
versions.promptTextZh: 选择最佳回答。

choices.label: The kitchen is well equipped.
It should be arriving soon.
The proper equipment is essential.
choices.labelZh: 合适的装备是必不可少的。
choices.explanationZh: 说话者问：“露营旅行我应该带什么？”最佳回答是“合适的装备是必不可少的”，这针对旅行所需物品的必要性给出了建议。

choices.label: Yes, the campus cafeteria can cater.
choices.labelZh: 是的，校园食堂可以提供餐饮。

versions.transcript: What should I bring to the camping trip?
versions.transcriptZh: 露营旅行我应该带什么？

transcriptSentences.text: What should I bring to the camping trip?
transcriptSentences.textZh: 露营旅行我应该带什么？

versions.note: 同题，材料文字版本不同

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: If you're comfortable with the schedule, we can book the lab for tomorrow.
versions.promptTextZh: 如果你觉得时间安排没问题，我们明天可以预约实验室。
versions.transcript: If you're comfortable with the schedule, we can book the lab for tomorrow.
versions.transcriptZh: 如果你觉得时间安排没问题，我们明天可以预约实验室。

choices.label: I think her office is on the second floor.
choices.labelZh: 我认为她的办公室在二楼。
choices.explanationZh: 原句在确认明天订实验室的安排，这句突然说某人的办公室位置，接不上。

choices.label: Yes, the lab equipment is brand-new.
choices.labelZh: 是的，实验室设备都是全新的。
choices.explanationZh: 这句只评价 lab equipment，新不新不等于同不同意明天订 lab。

choices.label: I haven't had time to read books recently.
choices.explanationZh: 读书时间和 booking the lab 没关系，话题直接换频道。

choices.label: Sure, that works for me.
choices.explanationZh: 对方提出“如果你觉得时间可以，我们就订明天”，这句明确表示这个安排可行。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: The school assembly was very engaging.
versions.promptTextZh: 学校的集会非常吸引人。
versions.transcript: The school assembly was very engaging.
versions.transcriptZh: 学校的集会非常吸引人。

choices.label: Assemble the group and we'll discuss the work project.
choices.labelZh: 召集大家，我们来讨论这个工作项目。
choices.explanationZh: 这句把 assembly 拆成动词 assemble，变成召集团队开工，词形相似但意思跑了。

choices.label: All of the students enjoyed it.
choices.explanationZh: 听力说 assembly 很吸引人，这句补充学生都喜欢它，评价方向一致。

choices.label: I was so engaged with the book that I finished it in one night.
choices.labelZh: 我对那本书太着迷了，一晚上就把它看完了。
choices.explanationZh: 这句抓了 engaged，但对象变成一本书，不是 school assembly。

choices.label: The school year begins earlier in some areas.
choices.labelZh: 有些地区的学年开始得更早。
choices.explanationZh: 这句抓 school，但在说学年开始时间，和 assembly 的效果无关。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: The clothing store has a new collection of shirts on display.
versions.promptTextZh: 这家服装店正在展示一个新款衬衫系列。
versions.transcript: The clothing store has a new collection of shirts on display.
versions.transcriptZh: 这家服装店正在展示一个新款衬衫系列。

choices.label: No, I haven't updated my stamp collection in quite some time.
choices.labelZh: 不，我已经有很长一段时间没更新我的集邮册了。
choices.explanationZh: 这句把 collection 偷换成邮票收藏，和服装店新品没有关系。

choices.label: Does this grocery store stock any frozen foods?
choices.labelZh: 这家杂货店有冷冻食品吗？
choices.explanationZh: 话题跑到 grocery store 和 frozen foods，跟 clothing store 里的 shirts 完全不是一个店。

choices.label: Yes, I purchased some of the new items yesterday.
choices.labelZh: 有，我昨天买了一些新款商品。
choices.explanationZh: 听力说店里有新款 shirts 展示，这句回应自己昨天买过新品，能自然接上这个信息。

choices.label: The teacher has displayed the various student projects.
choices.labelZh: 老师已经展出了各种各样的学生作品。
choices.explanationZh: 这句抓了 display，但场景变成老师展示学生项目，不是在聊商店陈列衣服。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: What time does the marching band practice?
versions.promptTextZh: 行进乐队什么时候练习？
versions.transcript: What time does the marching band practice?
versions.transcriptZh: 行进乐队什么时候练习？

choices.label: Practice is so important.
choices.explanationZh: 问的是具体时间，这句只是评论“练习”本身，听完还是不知道几点。

choices.label: On the football field this time.
choices.explanationZh: 答成了地点；如果原句是 Where does... 才可能对。

choices.label: I don't know but I'll find out for you.
choices.labelZh: 我不知道，但我会帮你查一下。
choices.explanationZh: 问时间时，不知道答案也可以接一句“我去查”，这是唯一一个在信息缺失时仍然能完成回应的选项。

choices.label: They marched in unison to the drum beat.
choices.labelZh: 他们随着鼓点齐步行进。
choices.explanationZh: 这句像在写阅兵画面，不是在回答练习几点。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: I assumed the cafeteria would serve breakfast until noon.
versions.promptTextZh: 我以为食堂会一直供应早餐到中午。
versions.transcript: I assumed the cafeteria would serve breakfast until noon.
versions.transcriptZh: 我以为食堂会一直供应早餐到中午。

choices.label: It's on the other side of campus.
choices.explanationZh: 这句回答的是 cafeteria 在哪里，不解释为什么早餐没有到 noon。

choices.label: Yes, the library has extended hours.
choices.labelZh: 是的，图书馆的开放时间延长了。
choices.explanationZh: 这句把营业时间换成 library，地点错了。

choices.label: Let's call her this afternoon.
choices.labelZh: 我们下午给她打电话吧。
choices.explanationZh: 原句不是在讨论某个人，也没有需要 call her 的信息。

choices.label: They changed the schedule last week.
choices.labelZh: 他们上周更改了时间表。
choices.explanationZh: 对方以为早餐供应到中午，这句解释实际安排变了，所以原来的假设不成立。

versions.label: Wofo M41
versions.promptText: Where can I find discounted textbooks?
versions.promptTextZh: 我在哪里能找到打折的教科书？
versions.transcript: Where can I find discounted textbooks?
versions.transcriptZh: 我在哪里能找到打折的教科书？

choices.label: Your best option is to look online.
choices.labelZh: 你最好的选择是上网找。
choices.explanationZh: 题干问去哪里找便宜教材，online 给出具体寻找渠道。

choices.label: I prefer reading nonfiction.
choices.labelZh: 我更喜欢读非小说类的书。
choices.explanationZh: 这是在说阅读偏好，不是在告诉对方哪里能买 discounted textbooks。

choices.label: Yes, I believe it is.
choices.explanationZh: 原句不是 yes/no 问句，答 yes 基本是对空气点头。

choices.label: I need reading glasses.
choices.explanationZh: 看到 reading 就跑去眼镜，和买教材不是一回事。

versions.transcript: Where can I find the best teaching materials?
versions.transcriptZh: 我在哪里可以找到最好的教学材料？

choices.label: Teaching requires patience.
choices.explanationZh: Teaching requires patience 泛泛谈教学。

choices.label: I usually look online.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：usually look online 回答哪里找 teaching materials。

choices.label: I need to organize my desk.
choices.explanationZh: organize desk 无关。

choices.label: It's important for her to prepare lessons.
choices.explanationZh: prepare lessons 是材料用途，不回答 where。

versions.transcriptZh: 我们学习时，你更喜欢喝茶还是喝咖啡？

choices.label: Neither, thank you.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：Neither, thank you 直接回应 tea or coffee 二选一。

choices.label: They've left already.
choices.explanationZh: They’ve left already 无关。

choices.label: Not very hot.
choices.explanationZh: Not very hot 回答温度。

choices.label: Sure, I can pour it.
choices.explanationZh: I can pour it 表示倒茶/咖啡，不回答偏好。

versions.label: Wofo M42
versions.promptText: The movie was a thrilling detective story.

versions.transcript: The movie was a thrilling detective story.
versions.transcriptZh: 这部电影是一部惊险刺激的侦探故事。

choices.label: It held my attention the entire time.
choices.labelZh: 它从头到尾都吸引着我的注意力。
choices.explanationZh: 正确：held my attention the entire time 是对 thrilling detective story 的自然评价。

choices.label: I need to finish my homework first.
choices.explanationZh: homework first 是行动安排，不评价电影。

choices.label: I was thrilled to see her as well.
choices.explanationZh: thrilled to see her 误用 thrilled。

choices.label: That sounds like a great class to take.
choices.labelZh: 听起来是个很棒的课程。
choices.explanationZh: great class to take 把 story 转成课程。

versions.promptTextZh: 你更倾向于定性研究方法还是定量研究方法？

versions.transcriptZh: 你更倾向于定性研究方法还是定量研究方法？

choices.label: I need to review both approaches before I can provide you with an answer.
choices.labelZh: 我需要先回顾两种方法，然后才能给你答复。
choices.explanationZh: 正确：需要 review both approaches，直接回应 qualitative or quantitative 的选择。

choices.label: Dr. Park's advice on quantum mechanics heavily influenced my research project.
choices.labelZh: 帕克博士关于量子力学的建议极大地影响了我的研究项目。
choices.explanationZh: quantum mechanics 只是音近 quantitative，主题不对。

choices.label: Method acting requires deep emotional commitment and rigorous study.
choices.labelZh: 方法派表演要求深层的情感投入和严格的学习。
choices.explanationZh: method acting 把 methods 转到表演。

choices.label: I've always preferred quality time in the mornings with quiet reflection.
choices.labelZh: 我一直更喜欢早晨宁静反思的优质时光。
choices.explanationZh: quality time 把 qualitative/quality 误解成休闲时间。

versions.label: Wofo M42
versions.promptText: Are you interested in joining the curriculum committee?
versions.promptTextZh: 你有兴趣加入课程委员会吗？
versions.transcript: Are you interested in joining the curriculum committee?
versions.transcriptZh: 你有兴趣加入课程委员会吗？

choices.label: Those clouds do seem full.
choices.labelZh: 那些云看起来确实很厚。
choices.explanationZh: clouds full 把 committee 听岔成天气语境。

choices.label: It should be a great concert.
choices.labelZh: 那应该会是一场很棒的音乐会。
choices.explanationZh: great concert 无关。

choices.label: I'm still thinking about it.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：still thinking about it 回应是否 interested in joining。

choices.label: It's a very interesting read.
choices.labelZh: 这是一篇非常有趣的读物。
choices.explanationZh: interesting read 把 interested 转到读物。

versions.promptTextZh: 俱乐部会议将持续多长时间？
versions.transcript: How long will the club meeting last?
versions.transcriptZh: 俱乐部会议将持续多长时间？

choices.label: It will be held at the dining hall.
choices.explanationZh: held at dining hall 是地点。

choices.label: The projector worked fine yesterday.
choices.explanationZh: projector worked fine 是设备情况。

choices.label: It depends on how focused the discussion is.
choices.labelZh: 这取决于讨论的专注程度。
choices.explanationZh: 正确：depends on discussion focus 回答 meeting last 多久。

choices.label: Meeting notes will be posted tomorrow.
choices.labelZh: 会议记录将于明天公布。
choices.explanationZh: notes posted tomorrow 是会后安排。

versions.promptText: How long will it take to receive the package?

versions.transcript: How long will it take to receive the package?
versions.transcriptZh: 包裹多久能收到？

choices.label: Our grades will be posted tomorrow.
choices.explanationZh: grades posted tomorrow 与 package 无关。

choices.label: The dorm supervisor is authorized to sign for it.
choices.explanationZh: dorm supervisor sign for it 讲签收人，不回答多久收到。

choices.label: It was sent yesterday.
choices.explanationZh: It was sent yesterday 提供寄出时间，但仍不能回答多久收到。

choices.label: You can track the status online.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：track the status online 是查询包裹到达时间的合理方式。

versions.label: Wofo M42
versions.promptText: Can you lend your expertise to help me learn a new dance?
versions.promptTextZh: 你能运用你的专长来帮我学一支新舞吗？
versions.transcript: Can you lend your expertise to help me learn a new dance?
versions.transcriptZh: 你能运用你的专长来帮我学一支新舞吗？

choices.label: Dance class is a lot of fun.
choices.explanationZh: dance class fun 是评价。

choices.label: Just give me a few minutes to rest first.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：give me a few minutes to rest first 表示愿意帮，但需要稍等。

choices.label: Yes, I thought so, too.
choices.explanationZh: Yes, I thought so too 像同意观点，不回应 help request。

choices.label: Let's meet them at the dance.
choices.labelZh: 我们去舞会上见他们吧。
choices.explanationZh: meet them at the dance 讲见面安排。

versions.label: Wofo M42
versions.promptText: Did you listen to the entire lecture?
versions.promptTextZh: 你听完整个讲座了吗？
versions.transcript: Did you listen to the entire lecture?
versions.transcriptZh: 你听完整个讲座了吗？

choices.label: It's usually very interesting.
choices.explanationZh: usually interesting 评价 lecture 类型，不回答是否听完整场。

choices.label: It was too long.

choices.label: He doesn't know.
choices.explanationZh: He doesn’t know 主体错误。

choices.label: Is it as long as last week's?
choices.explanationZh: as long as last week’s 是反问长度，不回答 Did you listen。

versions.label: Wofo M42
versions.promptText: What's your preferred outdoor activity?
versions.promptTextZh: 你最喜欢的户外活动是什么？
versions.transcript: What's your preferred outdoor activity?
versions.transcriptZh: 你最喜欢的户外活动是什么？

choices.label: The west campus entrance may be closed now.

choices.explanationZh: west campus entrance 讲入口关闭。

choices.label: I heard outdoor seating is limited.

choices.label: It depends on my mood.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：depends on my mood 回应 preferred outdoor activity。

choices.label: The student outdoor adventure club went there.
choices.labelZh: 学生户外探险俱乐部去过那里。
choices.explanationZh: outdoor adventure club 去那里，不说个人偏好。

versions.transcript: What sorts of books are you reading these days?
versions.transcriptZh: 你最近在读什么类型的书？

choices.label: An action movie would be a good choice.
choices.labelZh: 动作片会是个不错的选择。
choices.explanationZh: action movie 不是 books。

versions.promptText: Where did you put the new supplies for the instructor's office?
versions.promptTextZh: 你把给教师办公室的新用品放哪了？
versions.transcript: Where did you put the new supplies for the instructor's office?
versions.transcriptZh: 你把给教师办公室的新用品放哪了？

choices.label: They have great chemistry as friends.
choices.labelZh: 他们作为朋友相处得非常融洽。
choices.explanationZh: great chemistry as friends 把 supplies 语境转成 chemistry。

choices.label: The laboratory building across campus.
choices.labelZh: 在校园另一头的实验楼。
choices.explanationZh: 正确：The laboratory building across campus 是一个地点，最能回应 supplies 放在哪里。

choices.label: My classes start at eight a.m.
choices.explanationZh: classes start at eight 是时间。

choices.label: You can visit the department's website.
choices.labelZh: 你可以访问系里的网站。
choices.explanationZh: department website 可能查信息，但不回答 supplies 放在哪里。

versions.label: Wofo M42
versions.promptText: What time does the concert start in the auditorium?
versions.promptTextZh: 音乐厅的音乐会几点开始？
versions.transcript: What time does the concert start in the auditorium?
versions.transcriptZh: 音乐厅的音乐会几点开始？

choices.label: The play ended late in the evening.
choices.labelZh: 戏剧在晚上很晚才结束。
choices.explanationZh: play ended late 讲戏剧结束。

choices.label: Live music is the best music.
choices.labelZh: 现场音乐是最好的音乐。
choices.explanationZh: live music best 是评价。

choices.label: I'll have to check the tickets.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：check the tickets 是查询 concert start time 的合理方式。

choices.label: The band sold many tickets to the concert.
choices.labelZh: 乐队卖出了很多音乐会门票。
choices.explanationZh: tickets sold 讲销量，不回答 start time。

versions.label: Wofo M42
versions.promptText: How come you canceled the study session with our new classmates?
versions.promptTextZh: 你为什么取消了和新同学一起的学习小组活动？
versions.transcript: How come you canceled the study session with our new classmates?
versions.transcriptZh: 你为什么取消了和新同学一起的学习小组活动？

choices.label: Sometime tomorrow.
choices.explanationZh: Sometime tomorrow 回答时间。

choices.label: I have a scheduling conflict.
choices.explanationZh: 正确：scheduling conflict 解释 why canceled。

choices.label: It's in the top drawer.
choices.explanationZh: top drawer 是地点。

choices.label: Yes, I came by bus.
choices.explanationZh: came by bus 解释交通。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Do we need to register in advance for the film club trip?
versions.promptTextZh: 电影社出游需要提前报名吗？
versions.transcript: Do we need to register in advance for the film club trip?
versions.transcriptZh: 电影社出游需要提前报名吗？

choices.label: The session will be recorded for future access.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈录像，不回答是否预注册。

choices.label: Refreshments will be provided.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈茶点。

choices.label: It’s in the evening.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。只说时间在晚上。

choices.label: The flyer recommended it.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。用传单信息直接回答“要不要提前登记”。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Are you planning to join the running club?
versions.promptTextZh: 你打算加入跑步社吗？
versions.transcript: Are you planning to join the running club?
versions.transcriptZh: 你打算加入跑步社吗？

choices.label: I need to see if I have time for it.
choices.labelZh: 我得看看自己有没有时间。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。直接回应是否加入：取决于有没有时间。

choices.label: This chair is so comfortable.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈椅子，无关。

choices.label: They have a running argument about that.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。running argument 是“持续争吵”，干扰 running club。

choices.label: I went dancing at a club downtown.
choices.labelZh: 我去市中心的俱乐部跳过舞。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈跳舞俱乐部，偷换 club 含义。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Which dining hall do you prefer?
versions.promptTextZh: 你更喜欢哪个食堂？
versions.transcript: Which dining hall do you prefer?
versions.transcriptZh: 你更喜欢哪个食堂？

choices.label: Tomorrow sounds better.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。给时间偏好，不回答 which dining hall。

choices.label: No, they don’t serve fish.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈是否有鱼，不点名食堂。

choices.label: Yes, I’ll join you for dinner.
choices.labelZh: 好的，我跟你一起吃晚饭。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。答应共进晚餐，没说偏好哪个。

choices.label: The one in Sarah’s dorm.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。明确指出偏好的食堂。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: I thought the guest lecture this morning was really insightful.
versions.promptTextZh: 我觉得今早的客座讲座很有见地。
versions.transcript: I thought the guest lecture this morning was really insightful.
versions.transcriptZh: 我觉得今早的客座讲座很有见地。

choices.label: Yes, the arguments were so logical.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。用“论证很有逻辑”附和并具体化对讲座的正面评价。

choices.label: I don’t know why today’s lecture is postponed.
choices.labelZh: 不知道今天的课为什么推迟。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈课推迟，与“今早讲座很 insightful”不一致。

choices.label: Our department has guests visiting from abroad.
choices.labelZh: 我们系有外国客人来访。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈访客，不评价讲座内容。

choices.label: No, I didn’t think you’d show up so late.
choices.labelZh: 不，我没想到你会来这么晚。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在说对方迟到，完全偏题。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: How come the professor didn't mention the extra credit?
versions.promptTextZh: 教授怎么没提额外加分的事？
versions.transcript: How come the professor didn't mention the extra credit?
versions.transcriptZh: 教授怎么没提额外加分的事？

choices.label: Maybe it wasn’t planned initially.
choices.labelZh: 也许一开始就没计划这事。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。给出教授未提及 extra credit 的合理原因：起初未规划。

choices.label: He credited her for the award.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。credit 作“归功于”，跑题。

choices.label: I can’t take all the credit.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈个人揽功，无关课程加分。

choices.label: I think I know why he didn’t want to come.
choices.labelZh: 我想我知道他为什么不想来。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在解释某人缺席，不是未提及加分。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Does the task assume students possess background knowledge?
versions.promptTextZh: 这项任务是否假定学生已有背景知识？
versions.transcript: Does the task assume students possess background knowledge?
versions.transcriptZh: 这项任务是否假定学生已有背景知识？

choices.label: Yes, I can digitally remove the background.
choices.labelZh: 可以，我能用软件抠掉背景。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 background 理解成图片背景。

choices.label: Their experimental assumption was flawed.
choices.labelZh: 他们的实验假设有问题。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈实验假设 flawed，不回答任务是否要求先验知识。

choices.label: Next week, I think.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。给时间，不回答是否需要背景知识。

choices.label: Only from classes they’ve previously taken.
choices.labelZh: 只需要他们以前上过的课的知识。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。说明假定来源是先修课知识，直接回答问题。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Could you check whether the professor posted the lecture slides?
versions.promptTextZh: 你能帮我看下教授有没有上传课件吗？
versions.transcript: Could you check whether the professor posted the lecture slides?
versions.transcriptZh: 你能帮我看下教授有没有上传课件吗？

choices.label: No, they sent it to the wrong person.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在说寄错，不回应检查上传。

choices.label: Make sure you check the weather forecast.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈天气。

choices.label: Yes, I could add a few more slides.
choices.labelZh: 可以，我能再加几页幻灯片。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 slides 理解成自己去加页。

choices.label: I was just about to have a look.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。表示即将去查，承接请求。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Should we take a quick stab at the first problem in the assignment?
versions.promptTextZh: 我们要不要先试着做作业第一题？
versions.transcript: Should we take a quick stab at the first problem in the assignment?
versions.transcriptZh: 我们要不要先试着做作业第一题？

choices.label: It’s the last one.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。说是最后一题，与 first problem 冲突且未表态是否做。

choices.label: Hurry up so we don’t miss it.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。催促赶时间，对象不清。

choices.label: No, let’s not do anything unsafe.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 take a stab 字面理解成危险动作。

choices.label: Yes, let’s see if we can solve it.
choices.labelZh: 好，看看我们能不能解出来。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。同意尝试解题，匹配习语 take a stab at。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Why did class get delayed?
versions.promptTextZh: 课为什么推迟了？
versions.transcript: Why did class get delayed?
versions.transcriptZh: 课为什么推迟了？

choices.label: I am very late.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。说话人自己迟到不是“整班延误”的解释。

choices.label: I printed out the syllabus.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。打印大纲不导致延误。

choices.label: There was a small leak in the ceiling.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。天花板漏水是导致上课延误的具体原因。

choices.label: I didn’t expect to leave so soon.
choices.labelZh: 我没想到这么快就离开。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈离开时间预期，不解释延误。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: The cafe is out of coffee.
versions.promptTextZh: 咖啡馆没咖啡了。
versions.transcript: The cafe is out of coffee.
versions.transcriptZh: 咖啡馆没咖啡了。

choices.label: I hope we always stay friends.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。情感句，不解决没咖啡的问题。

choices.label: Let’s try the campus cafeteria instead.
choices.labelZh: 那我们改去校园食堂吧。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。提出可行替代地点，自然承接“没咖啡”。

choices.label: I haven’t been to the café yet.
choices.labelZh: 我还没去过那家咖啡馆。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。说自己没去过，不解决当下需求。

choices.label: That cake recipe sounds amazing.
choices.labelZh: 那个蛋糕做法听起来真棒。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈蛋糕食谱，偏离。

versions.label: Koala 08-20
versions.promptText: Choose the best response.
versions.promptTextZh: 选择最佳回答。

choices.label: I hope we always stay friends.
choices.labelZh: 我希望我们永远是朋友。

choices.label: Let's try the campus cafeteria instead.
choices.labelZh: 我们去校园自助餐厅吧。
choices.explanationZh: 咖啡馆已经没有咖啡了，因此选项 B 建议改去校园餐厅，在那里可以获得饮品，而不是继续留下，回应最恰当。

choices.label: I haven't been to the café yet.
choices.labelZh: 我还没去过那家咖啡馆。

choices.label: That cake recipe sounds amazing.
choices.labelZh: 那个蛋糕食谱听起来很棒。

versions.transcript: The cafe is out of coffee, should we stay?
versions.transcriptZh: 咖啡馆没咖啡了，我们还要待下去吗？

transcriptSentences.text: The cafe is out of coffee, should we stay?
transcriptSentences.textZh: 咖啡馆没咖啡了，我们还要待下去吗？

versions.note: 同题，材料文字版本不同

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: We shouldn't make a fuss over the professor's feedback.
versions.promptTextZh: 我们不该为教授的反馈大惊小怪。
versions.transcript: We shouldn't make a fuss over the professor's feedback.
versions.transcriptZh: 我们不该为教授的反馈大惊小怪。

choices.label: You’re right, let’s address the key points calmly.
choices.labelZh: 你说得对，我们冷静处理关键点。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。同意别 make a fuss，并提出冷静处理要点。

choices.label: I can’t seem to decide on a topic.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈选题困难，偏离反馈态度。

choices.label: I know, I asked the professor too.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在说自己也问过，没有对齐“别小题大做”。

choices.label: They asked us to send it back if we don’t need it.
choices.labelZh: 他们说不需要就寄回去。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在谈退货，无关。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Mind giving me a quick recap of the lecture?
versions.promptTextZh: 能给我快速复述一下讲座内容吗？
versions.transcript: Mind giving me a quick recap of the lecture?
versions.transcriptZh: 能给我快速复述一下讲座内容吗？

choices.label: I haven’t received them yet.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。them 指代不明，也不像复述讲座。

choices.label: It’s right across from the lab.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。给地点。

choices.label: I’ll give you my notes instead.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。无法/不便口头复述时，给笔记是贴切的替代回应。

choices.label: The lecture will start shortly.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。说讲座将开始，与“复述已听内容”相反。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: I thought the seminar was postponed. Was that not the case?
versions.promptTextZh: 我以为研讨会延期了。不是这样吗？
versions.transcript: I thought the seminar was postponed. Was that not the case?
versions.transcriptZh: 我以为研讨会延期了。不是这样吗？

choices.label: The seminar room is available to book.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈能否订房间，不澄清是否延期。

choices.label: I don’t know where it is either.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈地点未知。

choices.label: Not today, but we should submit it soon.
choices.labelZh: 今天不行，但我们该尽快交。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在谈交作业。

choices.label: I think it was rescheduled for next week.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。确认改期到下周，直接回答“是不是延期了”。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: What's the project you're working on?
versions.promptTextZh: 你在做的那个项目是什么？
versions.transcript: What's the project you're working on?
versions.transcriptZh: 你在做的那个项目是什么？

choices.label: The interview went well.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈面试结果，不说明项目是什么。

choices.label: There were lots of people.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。只说人多。

choices.label: It’s a presentation.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。直接说明项目类型是 presentation。

choices.label: Sure, I’m happy to help.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在答应帮忙，没回答项目内容。

versions.label: Wofo M43
versions.promptText: Are we expected to explicitly address alternative explanations?
versions.promptTextZh: 我们需要明确讨论其他可能的解释吗？
versions.transcript: Are we expected to explicitly address alternative explanations?
versions.transcriptZh: 我们需要明确讨论其他可能的解释吗？

choices.label: I think it’s 2110 Main Street.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。给地址，偏题。

choices.label: You can call me by my first name.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈称呼。

choices.label: Let’s mention those in the conclusion.
choices.labelZh: 我们在结论里提一下那些。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。同意处理 alternative explanations，并说明放在结论，完成学术任务回应。

choices.label: We expect the theater will reopen later this year.
choices.labelZh: 我们预计剧院今年晚些时候重开。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈剧院重开，无关。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: If you're near the dorm, could you ask about laundry hours?
versions.promptTextZh: 你要是在宿舍附近，能帮我问问洗衣时间吗？
versions.transcript: If you're near the dorm, could you ask about laundry hours?
versions.transcriptZh: 你要是在宿舍附近，能帮我问问洗衣时间吗？

choices.label: The library is open late tonight.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈图书馆开放时间。

choices.label: It’s next to the laundromat.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。给位置，但没答应去问 hours。

choices.label: I’ll find out and let you know.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。接下请求并承诺反馈结果。

choices.label: I thought the dorms would be cheaper.
choices.labelZh: 我以为住宿舍会更便宜。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈费用看法，不回应询问洗衣时间。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: If the library has quiet rooms, let's book one now.
versions.promptTextZh: 如果图书馆有安静室，我们现在就订一间吧。
versions.transcript: If the library has quiet rooms, let's book one now.
versions.transcriptZh: 如果图书馆有安静室，我们现在就订一间吧。

choices.label: No, we don’t need to return the books right away.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈还书，不回应订安静室。

choices.label: I guess that would help us concentrate.
choices.labelZh: 我想那样会有助于我们集中。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。同意订安静室，并说明有利于专注。

choices.label: We could get it from the bookstore instead.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。改去书店，偏离提议。

choices.label: The campus store is having a sale today.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈打折，无关。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: The cafe is packed. Should we find another spot to study?
versions.promptTextZh: 咖啡馆人满了。我们要不要另找地方学习？
versions.transcript: The cafe is packed. Should we find another spot to study?
versions.transcriptZh: 咖啡馆人满了。我们要不要另找地方学习？

choices.label: The bookstore has a great selection of those.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈书店选品，不回应换学习地点。

choices.label: I prefer to sit in the front row.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈座位前后，场景不符。

choices.label: Sure, there’s a quiet lounge nearby.
choices.labelZh: 好啊，附近有个安静的休息室。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。同意换地方并给出附近安静处，完整回应提议。

choices.label: Right, there’s no admission fee for students.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈门票，无关咖啡馆学习。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: Would you like to learn a new hobby?
versions.promptTextZh: 你想学一门新爱好吗？
versions.transcript: Would you like to learn a new hobby?
versions.transcriptZh: 你想学一门新爱好吗？

choices.label: I would love to study there.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。study there 像在谈地点，没回应是否学新爱好。

choices.label: It’s a great place to get everything.
choices.labelZh: 那是买齐东西的好地方。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈购物地点。

choices.label: That book has been really popular.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈书是否流行。

choices.label: I recommend online courses.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。推荐网课，是对“学新爱好”的具体、相关建议（也可理解为愿意并给路径）。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: The seminar starts at 9 o'clock.
versions.promptTextZh: 研讨会九点开始。
versions.transcript: The seminar starts at 9 o'clock.
versions.transcriptZh: 研讨会九点开始。

choices.label: I slept well—thanks.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在回应“睡得好吗”，与开会时间无关。

choices.label: Yes, we golfed nine holes.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 nine 接到高尔夫九洞。

choices.label: No, I haven’t seen it.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。没有澄清时间信息。

choices.label: Nine a.m. or nine p.m.?
choices.labelZh: 是上午九点还是晚上九点？
choices.explanationZh: 正确。九点缺上下午信息；追问 am/pm 是最贴切的回应。

versions.label: Koala 04-22
versions.promptText: Choose the best response.
versions.promptTextZh: 选择最佳回答。

choices.label: I recorded our interviews.
I missed your show last night.
choices.labelZh: 我错过了你昨晚的演出。

choices.label: I still have time to grab breakfast.

versions.transcript: The seminar starts at 10 am.

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: It'd be better to just buy a new computer.
versions.promptTextZh: 还不如直接买台新电脑。
versions.transcript: It'd be better to just buy a new computer.
versions.transcriptZh: 还不如直接买台新电脑。

choices.label: I like taking notes.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈记笔记，不评价买新电脑的建议。

choices.label: Yes, in the park.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。地点答非所问。

choices.label: No, on the bottom.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在说位置“底部”，无关。

choices.label: It’s quite expensive.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。对“买新电脑”提出费用顾虑，是针对建议本身的相关反应。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: The printer in the student lounge has gone haywire.
versions.promptTextZh: 学生休息室那台打印机彻底失灵了。
versions.transcript: The printer in the student lounge has gone haywire.
versions.transcriptZh: 学生休息室那台打印机彻底失灵了。

choices.label: Because it costs less that way.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。解释“更便宜”不回应打印机坏了。

choices.label: When will they finally get us a replacement?
choices.labelZh: 他们到底什么时候才能给我们换一台？
choices.explanationZh: 正确。设备坏了，追问何时更换是自然、相关的回应。

choices.label: Do you know where he went?
choices.explanationZh: 错误。gone haywire 不是“人走了”。

choices.label: Be careful not to step on the glass shards.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在说碎玻璃危险，与打印机故障无关。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: Looks like the library is quiet. Should we study there?
versions.promptTextZh: 图书馆好像很安静。我们要不要去那儿学习？
versions.transcript: Looks like the library is quiet. Should we study there?
versions.transcriptZh: 图书馆好像很安静。我们要不要去那儿学习？

choices.label: That’s right—the library holds a lot of events.
choices.labelZh: 对——图书馆经常办很多活动。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。说活动多反而与“安静、适合学习”的提议冲突。

choices.label: Yes, it might help us concentrate.
choices.labelZh: 好，那可能有助于我们集中注意力。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。同意去安静处学习，并说明有利于专注。

choices.label: No, I haven’t read that book yet.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈某本书是否读过，不回应要不要去图书馆学。

choices.label: Not now, my roommates are still sleeping.
choices.labelZh: 现在不行，我室友还在睡觉。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在拒绝回家/宿舍，场景对不上图书馆提议。

versions.label: Wofo M44
versions.promptText: Don't first-year students have to live on campus?
versions.promptTextZh: 一年级学生不是必须住校吗？
versions.transcript: Don't first-year students have to live on campus?
versions.transcriptZh: 一年级学生不是必须住校吗？

choices.label: I haven’t visited the library yet.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。与住校规定无关。

choices.label: There are some exceptions to this rule.
choices.labelZh: 这条规则也有一些例外。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。原句用反问确认规定；指出有例外，是对“是否必须”的有效回应。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈截止日期，偏题。

choices.label: I think we should stay in line a little longer.
choices.labelZh: 我觉得我们应该再多排一会儿队。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈排队，偏题。

versions.transcript: Could you square away the semester registration forms?
versions.transcriptZh: 你能把这学期注册表格办妥吗？

choices.label: I’ll take care of them now.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。square away 表示办妥/处理好；“现在就去处理”直接接下任务。

choices.label: It’s an interesting formation.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 formation 与 forms 混淆，谈队形。

choices.label: I didn’t go far away.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 square away 听成 far away。

choices.label: The gym membership is too expensive for me.
choices.labelZh: 健身房会员对我来说太贵了。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈健身会员，无关注册表格。

versions.transcriptZh: 实验报告里我们要不要先攻难题？

choices.explanationZh: 错误。tackle 这里是着手处理题目，不是拉绳子。

choices.label: Absolutely, let’s keep up the pace.
choices.labelZh: 当然，我们保持这个节奏。

choices.label: The weather forecast says it should stay clear tonight.
choices.labelZh: 天气预报说今晚会继续放晴。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈天气，无关。

choices.label: Yes, class was rescheduled for tomorrow.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈调课，无关写报告顺序。

versions.transcript: I thought the professor said the project was due Friday.

choices.label: I agree, we should do another round of revisions.
choices.labelZh: 我也觉得，我们应该再改一轮。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。像在同意继续修改，没有回应“截止日期是否弄错”。

choices.explanationZh: 正确。原句表达对截止日期的不确定；“有误会”直接解释信息可能不一致。

choices.labelZh: 我查的时候它不在那儿。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈某物不在位置，不回答作业何时交。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈天气，与提案无关。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 fly 理解成地点距离。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 fly 理解成航班。

choices.labelZh: 好主意——投影仪可以再调高点。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 vibe 当成可存放的东西。

choices.label: Do we need to repeat the steps?
choices.labelZh: 我们需要重复这些步骤吗？
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈步骤重复，与气氛无关。

versions.transcript: Why was the registrar's office closed early?
versions.transcriptZh: 注册办公室为什么提前关门了？

choices.label: There was a power outage.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。原句在问提前关门的原因；停电是合理、直接的解释。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。只说用品放哪，没有说明为什么早关。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。预约时间不能解释办公室为何提前关门。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。说话人住得远不是办公室关门的原因。

versions.transcriptZh: 你觉得我们晚饭前能把报告打完吗？

choices.label: Spaghetti and meatballs, I think.
choices.labelZh: 我想是意大利面和肉丸。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。只回应 dinner 的菜名，没回答报告能否在晚饭前完成。

versions.transcript: Are you comfortable reading the room during the next class and adjusting?
versions.transcriptZh: 下一堂课你能读懂现场气氛并做出调整吗？

choices.label: I pride myself on being adaptable.
choices.labelZh: 我一向以善于变通为荣。
choices.explanationZh: 正确。原句问对方是否善于观察课堂气氛并灵活调整；“以善于变通为荣”直接回应了“调整/适应”这一语用要求。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 reading the room 字面理解成刷墙，完全偏题，没有回应课堂互动能力。

choices.label: Yes, the library’s chairs are quite comfortable.
choices.labelZh: 是的，图书馆的椅子很舒服。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。抓 comfortable 的字面义谈椅子舒服，忽略 reading the room 的习语含义。

choices.label: I’d rather let a mechanic do the work.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 adjusting 当成修机器，话题从课堂应变跳到找技工，不能完成回应。

versions.promptText: I suggest we follow through with our study plan.

versions.transcript: I suggest we follow through with our study plan.
versions.transcriptZh: 我建议我们把学习计划坚持做完。

choices.label: I couldn’t follow what he was saying.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。follow through 这里是“坚持做完”，不是“听懂他说的话”。

choices.label: Agreed, I wouldn’t want to stop now.
choices.explanationZh: 正确。对方建议 follow through；“同意，不想现在停”直接表示会继续执行计划。

choices.label: But I can’t remember where it is!
choices.labelZh: 可是我不记得它在哪儿了！
choices.explanationZh: 错误。把 plan 误当成某个物件位置，没有回应是否继续执行。

versions.transcript: Is your doctor's appointment on Thursday or Friday?
versions.transcriptZh: 你的医生预约是周四还是周五？

choices.explanationZh: 错误。只说时长，没选周四还是周五。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈诊所规模，不回答日期。

choices.label: She’s a specialist.
choices.explanationZh: 错误。谈医生类型，不回答日期。

versions.transcript: Any chance you've finished the bibliography for our project?
versions.transcriptZh: 我们项目的参考文献你有可能已经做完了吗？

choices.label: Let’s take advantage of this opportunity.
choices.labelZh: 我们要利用好这个机会。
choices.explanationZh: 错误。鼓励抓机会，没回答是否完成参考文献。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。把这次说成已经过去的旅行。

choices.explanationZh: 错误。默认对方今天还是会去，和“去不了”相反。

choices.labelZh: 可你都盼户外社这次活动好几周了！

choices.explanationZh: 正确。直接回答对读书会没有兴趣。
